subject: RE: Cargo inquiry - 6000 MT steel pipes Iskenderun / Casablanca
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Mehmet Demir <m.demir@marmarabrokers.com.tr>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 14:22:00 +0300
Subject: RE: Cargo inquiry - 6000 MT steel pipes Iskenderun / Casablanca
To: management@etm-services.net

Dear colleagues,

Thank you for reverting. Following further confirmation from our shippers, the cargo volume has been revised upwards. We are now looking at 7,500 to 8,000 mts of API steel pipes (12m lengths). Laycan and loading port remain unchanged. Geared vessel still required, stowage factor approximately 2.50. Could you please come back to us with a freshly adjusted freight indication reflecting the increased quantity and the tween deck requirement?

Best regards,
Mehmet Demir
Marmara Brokers - Chartering
snippet: Cargo revised to 7,500-8,000 mts steel pipes, please revert with adjusted freight including tween deck requirement...

subject: RE: 10000 MT bagged cement Port Said / Dakar - counter freight
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Osama <osama@badrgroup.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:55:00 +0200
Subject: RE: 10000 MT bagged cement Port Said / Dakar - counter freight
To: management@etm-services.net

Dear Sirs,

Thank you for your offer of USD 28.50/mt. After careful consideration, your rate is too high for our principals at this stage.

Our maximum acceptable freight is USD 25.00/mt FIO basis.

For reference, our full counter terms:
Cargo: 10,000 mts portland cement in 50kg pp bags
       bale capacity req min 12,500 cbm
Load: Port Said area, Egypt - 1 sb aaaa
Disch: Dakar, Senegal - 1 sb aaaa
Laycan: 01-10 Oct 2026
Loading: 2,000 mts SHINC
Disch: 1,500 mts SSHEX EIU
FRT counter: USD 25.00/mt FIO
Demurrage: USD 6,000 PDPR / FD BENDS
Commission: 3.75% TTL

Kindly revert with owners best.

brgds
Osama
Badr Group International
snippet: Counter freight USD 25.00/mt FIO vs your USD 28.50 - 10,000 MT bagged cement Port Said / Dakar...
